  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools

  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we rarely outsource recruitment.

title: Team Lead Education
description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one.

This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth.

Key Responsibilities

Application security (the core of the role)

  • Review code every week to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Find, prioritize and drive fixes for real vulnerabilities across the stack, not surface-level issues

Audits and pentests

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests

  • Challenge findings where needed, and follow them through to fixes

Engineering and automation

  • Automate security work and build the tools you need to scale it

  • Use AI tools daily in your security work: code review, pentests and scripting

Ownership and communication

  • Own security end to end with little support, and decide what matters most

  • Explain technical risk in plain words to the team and leadership

  • Cover security alerts, including occasional night and weekend on-call

Also part of the role (lighter)

  • Share security updates with the team and run awareness training

  • Audits and pentests: you’ve coordinated an external audit or pentest and followed the findings through to fixes

  • Engineering workflows: you ship code with Git/GitHub, script in Python or Bash, and have recent hands-on work on a modern web stack (e.g. Rails, Node; GCP, Heroku or similar)

  • Ownership with little support: you’ve been the sole or lead security person, or owned a security area on your own. You’ve reviewed code or tested systems every week in the last 2 years, and you explain risk clearly to non-technical people

  • AI in your daily work: you use AI tools every day in your security work

Nice-to-haves

  • ⭐ AI/LLM security testing (prompt injection, jailbreaking): a strong plus

  • GRC awareness

  • Familiarity with MDM and access management

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

title: Applied AI Engineer, Large Enterprise
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Munich/Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

  • Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

  • Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

  • Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

  • Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

  • Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

  • Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a demonstrated track record of 5+ years of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

  • Are fluent in both German and English

  • Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

  • Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Product Qualification Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will execute product qualification activities, turning qualification plans into robust test setups, reliable bench data, and clear, traceable evidence that supports product release.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Reliability Engineer, Product Engineering team, and external laboratories and OSAT partners to plan and execute qualification testing. You will develop test hardware in collaboration with external partners, coordinate the design of test PCBs and fixtures, select and configure test equipment, and ensure every qualification campaign produces accurate, well-documented, and reproducible results.

Your core focus will be to transform qualification requirements into practical test solutions, execute high-quality validation campaigns, and deliver the reliable data needed to make confident product qualification and release decisions.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Run product qualification testing by performing bench and laboratory qualification tests (thermal, electrical, mechanical, and environmental stress tests) in accordance with qualification plans and test matrix, while accurately tracking samples, test conditions, and results.

  • Develop test PCBs and fixtures with external partners, work on test boards, adapters, and fixtures, from requirements through review and bring-up.

  • Set up and maintain qualification test equipment, including thermal chambers, power supplies, data acquisition systems (DAQ), probe stations, and other laboratory instrumentation, ensuring the lab is always ready to support qualification activities.

  • Coordinate qualification campaigns with OSATs and external laboratories by managing schedules, sample logistics, and test execution, while providing on-site or remote test supervision where needed

  • Collect, analyze, and document qualification results, producing clear pass/fail assessments, comprehensive test reports, and fully traceable records that contribute to the overall product qualification evidence package.

  • Identify and communicate risks early, proactively escalating test failures, equipment limitations, data anomalies, or schedule risks to the Package Reliability Engineer and Quality & Reliability Program Lead to keep qualification activities on track.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

  • Experience testing RF and high-speed I/O, including high-speed serial, RF, or optical links using equipment such as vector network analyzers (VNAs), high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, BERTs, and other signal integrity measurement tools. This is a core requirement for the role, as experience limited to low-speed digital or logic circuit testing is not sufficient. Experience with photonics testing is a strong advantage.

  • Proficiency with laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, power supplies, thermal chambers, data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and, ideally, RF and high-speed characterization equipment such as VNAs, BERT, and high-bandwidth scopes.

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

  • Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

  • Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

  • Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

  • Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

  • Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Codesphere is entering complex, high-stakes regulated markets where winning a tender requires much more than project management. title: Hands-on Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
description:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks associated with power availability, thermal loading, EMC performance, reliability, safety, integration complexity, and operational resilience. 

  • Act as a technical authority across electrical power systems, collaborating closely with avionics, controls, software, thermal, mechanical, EMC, and systems engineering teams to deliver robust vehicle capability. 


Who you are 

  • An experienced Power Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex electrical power, energy storage, avionics, aerospace, defence, automotive, space, or other mission-critical systems. 

  • Strong background in electrical system architecture, requirements management, systems integration, verification, and validation across the full engineering lifecycle. 

  • Deep understanding of electrical power generation, power conversion, battery systems, energy storage, power distribution, protection systems, and power electronics. 

  • Experienced in electrical analysis including load-flow studies, transient response, fault analysis, protection coordination, power quality, thermal performance, and reliability assessments.

  • Familiar with systems engineering and MBSE approaches, using structured methods to manage complexity, interfaces, traceability, and technical risk. 

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, qualification campaigns, integration programmes, and the transition from concept through detailed design and verification. 

  • Technically credible across multiple engineering disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction. 

  • Comfortable operating in ambitious, fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly and engineering decisions have significant programme impact. 

  • Motivated by solving difficult engineering problems and delivering technologies that strengthen European sovereign defence capability. 


What we offer 
 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 


Security and Eligibility Requirement 
 

Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

Arbeitest du gerne in einem vertrauensvollen und dynamischen Umfeld?

Dann könnte Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich sein und du die perfekte Ergänzung für unser Team 🙂

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste Finanzbetriebssystem für europäische KMU werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern, den Zeitaufwand für Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu reduzieren. Gleichzeitig erhalten sie Zugang zu wichtigen Informationen, die ihnen helfen, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Steuerkanzleien. Mit Pennylane können sie manuelle und repetitive Aufgaben reduzieren und mehr Zeit darauf verwenden, ihre Mandantinnen und Mandanten zu beraten und zu begleiten.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen Frankreichs. Derzeit beschleunigen wir unsere Expansion nach Deutschland 🇩🇪

In sechs Jahren haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als innovative Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerkanzleien etabliert.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro an Finanzierung eingeworben, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem bekannten Venture-Capital-Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal investiert hat.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von sieben Mitgründern zu einem Team von über 1.200 zufriedenen Mitarbeitenden gewachsen. Heute gelten wir als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in Frankreich und als attraktiver Arbeitgeber für Remote-Arbeit. Auf Glassdoor haben wir eine Bewertung von 4,6 von 5.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 vertretenen Nationalitäten geschaffen. Unsere Kultur ist stark auf Remote-Arbeit ausgerichtet, und bereits 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden arbeiten aus verschiedenen Ländern Europas.

🤝 Wir genießen das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kundinnen und Kunden sowie Steuerkanzleien und erhalten hervorragende Bewertungen.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich.

Strategy & Operations bei Pennylane

Teil des Strategy-&-Operations-Teams bei Pennylane zu sein bedeutet, die operativen Realitäten genau zu verstehen. Während wir unsere deutsche Gesellschaft aufbauen, entwickeln und implementieren wir effiziente und skalierbare Lösungen, die Pennylane dabei unterstützen, seine ambitionierten Expansionsziele zu erreichen.

Deine Rolle wird entscheidend dazu beitragen, lokale Abläufe von Grund auf zu strukturieren, bestehende Prozesse zu skalieren und unser Operating Model an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes anzupassen.

Um diesen Markteintritt erfolgreich zu gestalten, arbeiten unsere Strategy-&-Operations-Teams täglich eng mit den Business-Teams, beispielsweise in Sales und Customer Success, den Tech-Teams, darunter Entwicklerinnen, Entwickler und Product Managerinnen und Product Manager, sowie den Data-Teams, darunter Data Scientists und Data Analysts, zusammen.

Dein Ziel

Du steigerst die Produktivität unserer Teams deutlich, indem du die Nutzung unserer Tools optimierst, Prozesse vereinfachst und operative Strukturen aufbaust, die den Aufbau und die Expansion unserer deutschen Gesellschaft unterstützen.

Dein täglicher Beitrag

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bist die zentrale Ansprechperson und treibst Veränderungen in den Business-Teams für den deutschen Markt voran.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den operativen Verantwortlichen aus den Bereichen Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support und Account Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Transformation vorantreiben und den Status quo hinterfragen: Du beobachtest, hörst zu, stellst bestehende Strukturen infrage und schlägst kontinuierlich Optimierungen vor, um den Zeitaufwand für manuelle administrative Aufgaben und die Datensuche zu reduzieren. Du schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum in Deutschland, strukturierst die Abläufe einer neuen Gesellschaft und dokumentierst alle Prozessänderungen.

  • Operative Verbesserungen umsetzen: Du setzt lösungsorientierte Initiativen durch die Einführung neuer Informationssysteme, die Anpassung bestehender Anwendungen oder organisatorische Veränderungen um. Dabei leitest du Projekte und nutzt das Know-how verschiedener Teams, darunter Data, Sales und Finance. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört außerdem, eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen, Zeitpläne einzuhalten und die relevanten KPIs der Implementierung zu überwachen.

  • Prozesse skalieren und lokalisieren: Du passt globale operative Strukturen an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes an und stellst gleichzeitig sicher, dass sie mit den zentralen Pennylane-Standards übereinstimmen.

  • Benchmarking und Innovation: Du beobachtest andere Abteilungen, trittst einen Schritt vom Tagesgeschäft zurück, führst Benchmarks durch und sammelst Erkenntnisse, um unsere operativen Strategien weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Teams befähigen und die Akzeptanz neuer Lösungen fördern: Du etablierst klare Kommunikationswege und praxisnahe Unterstützung für die deutschen Teams, damit sie sich reibungslos in neue Methoden und Arbeitsweisen einfinden, beispielsweise durch optimierte Tools, Schulungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen. Du stellst sicher, dass Tools im Alltag genutzt und Prozesse eingehalten werden.

  • Die Schnittstelle zwischen Operations und Unternehmensstrategie bilden: Du entwickelst ein übergreifendes Verständnis für die Herausforderungen des Unternehmens, um frühzeitig zu erkennen, wie sie sich auf unsere lokalen Aktivitäten in Deutschland auswirken. Mithilfe datenbasierter Erkenntnisse schaffst du mehr Transparenz über unsere operativen Abläufe.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine ambitionierte Persönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfahrung in der organisatorischen Transformation, der Steigerung der Produktivität, im Projektmanagement und im Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Deine Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du verfügst über mindestens vier Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Business-Transformation und in der Steigerung operativer Effizienz durch die Implementierung von Systemen und Tools.

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit Markteintritten, dem Aufbau neuer Gesellschaften oder der Skalierung operativer Strukturen gesammelt oder bringst eine starke Motivation für diese Themen mit.

  • Du zeichnest dich durch natürliche Neugier und den Wunsch aus, einen echten Beitrag zu leisten. Du hörst aktiv zu und beobachtest genau.

  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung im End-to-End-Projektmanagement. Du kannst Probleme schnell erfassen, zügig Lösungen umsetzen und iterativ arbeiten, ohne auf Perfektion zu warten.

  • Du kannst zwischen detaillierten Einzelheiten und einer übergeordneten strategischen Perspektive wechseln.

  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Geschäftsverständnis.

  • Du besitzt sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zusammenfassen.

  • Du interessierst dich für künstliche Intelligenz, No-Code-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung oder hast bereits Erfahrung in diesen Bereichen gesammelt.

  • Du verfügst über starke analytische Fähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in SQL sind von Vorteil.

  • Erfahrung mit SaaS-Geschäftsmodellen sowie Tools wie Salesforce und Intercom ist von Vorteil.

Was wir dir bieten

🏢 Diese Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. Du arbeitest an einigen Tagen pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43-45.

💵 Wir bieten ein attraktives Vergütungspaket. Die Details besprechen wir im Laufe des Bewerbungsprozesses.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile und kannst so am Erfolg teilhaben, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Homeoffice sowie eine monatliche Pauschale für die Nutzung eines Coworking-Spaces, wann immer du möchtest.

⛹️ Über unseren Partner Gymlib erhältst du Zugang zu 8.000 Fitness- und Sporteinrichtungen in Europa sowie zu mehr als 300 Wellness- und Freizeitaktivitäten.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu verbessern.

💻 Du erhältst modernste Apple-Ausstattung.

🎉 Regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen: Wir legen großen Wert darauf, Zeit miteinander zu verbringen, zum Beispiel bei unseren vierteljährlich stattfindenden Tech Days, unserem jährlichen Company Seminar sowie bei Team-Treffen etwa einmal im Monat in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43-45.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

  • Erstes Gespräch: 30-minütiges Videogespräch mit Thomas, unserem Recruiter.

  • Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager: 45-minütiges Videogespräch mit Alexandre, Chief of Staff Germany.

  • Case Study:

    • Praktische Übung mit zwei Strategy-&-Operations-Managerinnen oder -Managern von Pennylane in einem 60-minütigen Videogespräch.

    • Gespräch vor Ort zum gegenseitigen Kennenlernen: Gespräch mit einer Person aus dem Sales- oder PSM-Team.

  • Finale Runde: Treffen mit dem Team vor Ort, gefolgt von einem 30-minütigen Videogespräch mit Eric Scaramozzino, VP Strategic Initiatives, und Tobias Janiesch, General Manager.

Wir arbeiten zügig. Der gesamte Bewerbungsprozess dauert in der Regel zwischen 15 und 25 Tagen.

Wir haben versucht, dir so viele Informationen wie möglich über die Ziele, Aufgaben und das Umfeld dieser Position zu geben. Jetzt bist du an der Reihe: Zeig uns, ob du glaubst, dass diese Position dir die Möglichkeit bietet,

a) Spaß an deiner Arbeit zu haben und

b) einen wertvollen Beitrag zu unserem Unternehmen zu leisten.

Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Im schlimmsten Fall investierst du ein paar Minuten, im besten Fall ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten außerdem betonen, dass wir Vielfalt voll und ganz unterstützen und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und inklusives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen ein. Vielfalt macht Pennylane zu einem noch besseren und angenehmeren Arbeitsplatz.

Als konkretes Beispiel für unser Engagement haben wir kürzlich den Pacte Parité unterzeichnet, um in den kommenden Jahren konkrete Ziele für einen besseren und inklusiveren Arbeitsplatz zu setzen.

Pennylane fördert Vielfalt in all ihren Formen und setzt sich für ein inklusives, wertschätzendes und erfüllendes Arbeitsumfeld ein, sowohl in unseren Büros als auch im Rahmen der Remote-Arbeit. Wir bieten allen Menschen unabhängig von ihrem Hintergrund, ihrer Herkunft, ihrem Geschlecht, ihrer Religion, ihrer sexuellen Orientierung oder einer Behinderung die gleichen Chancen und behandeln alle Bewerberinnen und Bewerber im Bewerbungsprozess gleichberechtigt.

title: Customer Care Specialist - Spend - FinTech or Accounting Platform - German Speakers
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Join Perk as a key member of our Customer Care team for our Spend platform. Where you will play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional customer experiences. As a representative of Perk, you’ll help resolve a variety of inquiries, provide insightful support, and ensure every interaction contributes to our commitment to excellence.

Perk Spend is Perk’s spend-management platform, bringing employee expenses, supplier invoices and corporate card payments together in one place so finance teams can manage company spending alongside our Travel product

In this role, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams and learn our ever-evolving product suite, helping customers navigate their needs while upholding our values of transparency, empathy, and efficiency.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer queries via email and phone in a timely and knowledgeable manner

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues while providing accurate information and following up as needed

  • Document interactions and escalate complex cases to the appropriate teams

  • Ownership of incoming requests from customers, including the creation of tickets for the internal organization

  • Ownership for tracking-to-resolution of recorded incidents or bugs

  • Answering and handling customer inquiries for our customers for our German speaking clients.

  • Internally, you’re the first point of contact for knowledge on the operational use of our software

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in FinTech, financial or accounting software companies is a must have

  • Experience providing technical support and troubleshooting technical issues directly with customers

  • A background working in finance and or accounting is a strong plus

  • Operational experience with a high volume of external customer inquiries and internal clarifications from the team

  • Experience working towards KPIs across multiply channels such as phone, email and chat

  • Ability to handle a variety of tasks at a high frequency

  • Structured and detail oriented approach to work

  • Fluency in English and German, additional languages are a plus

 
 

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support


Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Assessment + Team manager interview - In person in our Berlin office
Final interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Account Executive Nordics
description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the role

Litmus is hiring an Account Executive to own and grow new business with industrial manufacturers across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland and Finland.

Litmus is an industrial DataOps and edge AI platform. We help manufacturers connect, normalize and use data from their plants, from shop-floor assets up to the cloud. Our customers use Litmus to break down OT data silos and scale analytics and AI across sites.

You will be the face of Litmus in the Nordics. You will build pipeline, run complex enterprise sales cycles end to end, and work closely with our pre-sales team, hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) and system integrators. You will report in to the VP EMEA.

What you will do

• Own a Nordic territory and its revenue target, from prospecting to signed contract and expansion.

• Build and qualify pipeline through outbound, events, partners and inbound leads.

• Run discovery with plant, operations, OT and IT stakeholders up to C-level, and map their business case for change.

• Lead structured, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value, commercial proposals and negotiation.

• Work hand in hand with pre-sales on demos, solution design and technical validation.

• Co-sell with hyperscalers and system integrators, and develop partner-sourced opportunities in your region.

• Keep forecasts and opportunity data accurate in Salesforce.

• Expand existing accounts from first site to multi-site and global rollouts.

• Bring market feedback back to product, marketing and leadership.

What you bring

Segment experience (required)

• 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven record of meeting or beating quota.

• Direct sales experience in industrial software: IIoT, industrial DataOps, data historians, MES, SCADA, edge computing or manufacturing analytics.

• A solid grasp of the OT/IT landscape in manufacturing, and of how plant data flows from machines to the cloud.

• Experience selling into manufacturing, process industries, energy or similar industrial sectors.

Nordic market knowledge (required)

• An established network among industrial manufacturers in the Nordics.

• A working understanding of Nordic buying culture, decision-making and procurement.

• Familiarity with the regional partner and system integrator landscape.

• Fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or Finnish).

How you work

• Comfortable running long, complex deals with many stakeholders.

• Disciplined in qualification and forecasting (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or similar).

• Self-driven and at ease building a territory in a growing team.

Nice to have

• Experience selling alongside Microsoft, AWS, Google or Databricks.

• Track record of displacing incumbent industrial software, such as historians or legacy integration tools.

• Experience in an early-stage or scale-up team in a new region.

Travel and location

• Up to 40% travel within the Nordics and to EMEA team and partner events.

• Based in the Nordics, ideally near Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen or Helsinki.
