title: Software Engineer II, System Integration
description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

At Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies we have the exciting challenge of building and integrating a core technology platform into multiple brands across many different regions. Critical to the success of this endeavor are the software integration engineers who serve as our critical interface and system advocate with domain teams across the vehicle. As a software integration engineer you will be the go-to person for system understanding, issue triage, system development, and escalation and as a result have opportunities to work across the entire vehicle system.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

Responsibilities

  • Directly support bring up of new platforms and software integration from the prototype stage all the way through production

  • Drive development, integration and delivery of new system features, filling in wherever necessary technically to achieve system goals

  • Drive necessary test automation and fleet monitoring tools to ensure persistent quality of vehicle features

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with feature partners and domain teams to improve system design, test coverage, and resolve issues

  • Perform fleet-level analysis of system performance to drive development and integration priorities

  • Travel as necessary to work with domain counterparts and grow your own understanding of vehicle systems and tools.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field

  • Experience developing in Python (preferred), Rust (preferred), C, C++,, Golang, or

  • Experience with systems engineering and analysis

  • Experience working on complex, cross-functional, distributed embedded systems

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a continuous integration environment

  • Experience with networked embedded systems (CAN, Ethernet, LIN, DOIP, ISOTP)

  • Experience with embedded flashing protocols (UDS, XCP)

  • Familiarity with vehicle diagnostics and common UDS services

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts

  • Experience with TCP/IP systems, IPv4/6, HTTP/Rest, gRPC

  • Experience with systems engineering analysis tools (FMEA, DFMEA, HARA)

  • Experience with industry tools such as Canalyzer, PCAN-Explorer, Wireshark

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

Candidate Data Privacy

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

If you provide a mobile telephone number as part of your application or during the recruitment process, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use that number to contact you via SMS text message for recruitment-related purposes, including scheduling, logistics, and status updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any text message you receive from us. Consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of applying for or being considered for employment.

Please see our Candidate Data Privacy Notice (English) and Candidate Data Privacy Notice (Serbian) for more information.

title: (Senior) Influencer Marketing Manager DACH (m/w/d)
description:

  • Budget- & Portfolio-Ownership: Du verantwortest den Großteil unseres monatlichen Kooperationsbudgets im sechsstelligen Bereich eigenständig. Du steuerst ein hochvolumiges Portfolio aus Always-on-Creatorn, Performance-Partnern und Top-Creatorn und allokierst Budgets nach CAC, NC ROAS und Skalierungspotenzial. Du bist bereit, Budgets konsequent umzuschichten, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen.

  • Datenanalyse auf Expertenniveau: Du analysierst die Performance über den gesamten Funnel, von CPM und CTR über CVR und AOV bis zu CAC, NC ROAS und LTV. Du baust Dashboards und Forecasts selbst und kannst jederzeit belegen, warum eine Kooperation performt hat oder nicht. Deine Analysen sind die Grundlage für Budgetentscheidungen im Management.

  • Creator-Beziehungen & Verhandlung: Du bringst ein belastbares Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Management-Agenturen mit und baust es weiter aus. Du führst anspruchsvolle Vertrags- und Rahmenverhandlungen mit Top-Creatorn und Agenturen und entwickelst Vergütungsmodelle für nachhaltig hohen NC ROAS und langfristige Partnerschaften.

  • Kreatives Testing mit System: Du denkst in Hypothesen und isolierst Variablen sauber. Du planst Testing-Roadmaps für Produkte, Hooks, Formate und Angles, wertest sie statistisch belastbar aus und überführst die Learnings in Briefings, Bundles und Landingpages.

  • KI als Hebel und neuer Standard: Du setzt KI dort ein, wo sie Qualität und Geschwindigkeit steigert, zum Beispiel bei Creator-Scouting und -Scoring, Performance-Auswertung, Briefing-Erstellung oder Content-Analyse. Du entwickelst daraus Workflows und Best Practices, die das ganze Team nutzt, und hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse kritisch.

  • Konzeption, Bundles & Verkaufspsychologie: Du übersetzt Daten in messerscharfe, kreative Creator-Briefings, konzipierst unwiderstehliche Produkt-Bundles und gestaltest Landingpages mit, gezielt mit verkaufspsychologischen Triggern für maximale Conversion.

  • Schnittstelle zum Performance-Team: Du bist der verlängerte Arm von Paid Media. Du erkennst, welcher Creator-Content als Ad auf Meta oder TikTok performt, sicherst die nötigen Nutzungsrechte und lieferst dem Team laufend frisches Creative-Futter.

DAS BIST DU

Du hast Lust in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das sich für einen nachhaltigeren Lifestyle einsetzt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung von Tag 1, gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Startup-Umfeld wohl? Du kannst komplexe Performance-Daten über den gesamten Funnel hinweg eigenständig auswerten, Zusammenhänge erkennen, bevor andere sie sehen, und daraus klare Budgetentscheidungen ableiten. This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. 

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. 

About You:

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to join our delivery team in our Munich office.

  • You know the challenges in manufacturing and operations, and you believe in putting the operator in the center
  • You can take on and lead projects with complex stakeholder landscapes
  • You are comfortable communicating with customer stakeholders from the shop floor to the C-suite
  • You're flexible and can thrive in environments that don't have defined processes, and you're excited to help build
  • those processes
  • You have experience working in a startup environment or at a minimum are ready to take the plunge.

What skills do I need?

  • BS Degree: Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Management, Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of work experience; prior experience in project management and manufacturing or process engineering is - a plus
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. title: Social Media & External Communication Manager
description:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will own how Agent F and its founder show up in the world: on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube, on the blog and in the newsletter, in the press, on podcasts and stages, and in the ecosystem around us. You will create and distribute content every day, run the founder’s profiles, manage relationships with journalists and media makers, and keep the network warm.

The bar is concrete. At least one to two good pieces of content go out every day. The audience grows, and it is the right audience: finance and operations leaders, founders and the people around them. Inbound interest arrives that can be traced back to something you published. You will have the founder’s time, the customers’ stories and the product’s progress as raw material; turning that into a consistent, credible voice is your job.

You will work closely with the Online Marketing Manager, who owns paid channels and the funnel. You own the organic, owned and earned side: the brand, the voice, the content and the relationships.

What you will build and own

  • The founder’s presence. Positioning, editorial calendar, drafting and publishing, replies and community. The founder reviews; you run it.

  • The company’s channels. LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, blog, newsletter. One voice, one visual identity, a cadence that does not slip.

  • Daily content. Posts, short videos, articles, visuals. Take one idea and make it work across formats and channels.

  • External communication. Press relations, podcasts, events and speaking, launches and announcements, partner communication; working with PR agencies where engaged.

  • The network. Journalists, podcasters, communities and ecosystem contacts, kept on a live list and in a warm relationship.

  • Brand assets. Guidelines, templates and tone of voice, kept current and actually used.

For example, a customer goes live and their CFO says something memorable in the final call. You would turn it into a founder post the same day, a short video for the company channel the next, a line in the newsletter and a pitch to a journalist who covers finance software, and track what came back from each.

What you bring

You have three or more years in content, social media or communications for a B2B company or a founder brand, with proof of an audience you built and content you shipped at pace. You write clearly in German and English, edit short video and work with design tools and AI tools every day.

You understand finance, software or the Mittelstand well enough to write for a demanding audience without embarrassing yourself or us. You can show us a channel you grew, a piece that worked and one that did not, and a press placement you earned. You are fast, consistent and allergic to empty posts, and you are comfortable approaching journalists and strangers.

Core experience

  • Daily content production across LinkedIn and at least one video platform, with measurable audience growth.

  • Writing in German and English for a professional audience; editing short video; working with design and AI tools.

  • Running a founder’s or an executive’s public profile.

  • Press and media relations: pitching, placing, maintaining relationships.

  • Community and network management in a B2B context.

  • Reading analytics and adjusting content to what works.

Useful additional experience

Experience in fintech, software or Mittelstand communications; newsletter growth; event and speaking logistics; working with PR agencies; podcast production.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would set the editorial rhythm for the founder and the company, get daily publishing running, refresh the channels and the brand assets, and place the first press and podcast appearances around our announcements.

We would look for the daily cadence holding, audience growing in the right segments, engagement rising and the first inbound conversations that trace back to content.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a brand that is consistent and a voice that is credible. Content ships daily, including during launches and travel. Press and public reactions are monitored and answered the same day.

When an announcement, a launch or a public issue needs attention outside normal hours, you are there, you keep the founder informed and you handle it with judgement.

How you will work

You report to the CEO and work closely with the founder on their presence, with the Online Marketing Manager on content and amplification, and with sales on customer stories. You will use AI tools for drafting, editing and analysis and remain responsible for the voice and the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. German and English are required.

title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
description:
Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances.

We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.

We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them.

  • Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud.

  • Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems.

  • Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles.

  • Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards.

  • Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field.

  • Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team.



What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code.

  • A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

  • The ability to understand a complex system and its domain quickly, and to translate that understanding into clear architecture and well-scoped tasks.

  • Hands-on experience working with AI coding agents, or the curiosity and drive to build that skill fast, including the judgment to verify and correct what they produce.

  • Day-to-day experience with Linux as a development and target environment.

  • Experience with distributed, real-time or performance-critical systems.

  • A solid testing mindset, from unit tests to hardware-in-the-loop or simulation.

  • Clear communication and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience with robotics, autonomy or sensor integration.

  • Experience setting up agent-based workflows, such as parallel agents, automated test and review loops or custom tooling around coding agents.

  • Embedded or real-time experience (RTOS, bare metal, firmware).

  • Familiarity with ROS 2 or simulation frameworks.

  • Knowledge of communication protocols and low-latency data transport.

  • Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.

title: (Senior) B2G Manager: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
description:
“This is not your typical B2G role.”

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at.

Why this role exists

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers.

What you'll own

  • Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved.

  • Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes.

  • Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more municipalities.

  • Turn municipalities into customers. Win cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies that use RIZM for heat planning, climate strategy and business park development. Set up offers and procurement routes for the public sector.

  • Orchestrate the ecosystem. Bring chambers of commerce (IHKs), economic development agencies, utilities and industry partners together in joint projects.

  • Build the data foundation. Tap into public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

  • Create visibility. References with municipalities and mayors that show publicly what's happening in their region.

  • Leadership. Over time, build a small B2G team, including working students.

You're a fit if you

  • Have several years of experience in the public sector, politics, municipal utilities, economic development agencies, associations or funding management.

  • Have successfully won funding (EU, federal, state) or led consortia.

  • Know how municipalities make decisions and buy, and have a strong network in NRW or beyond.

  • Understand energy transition topics such as municipal heat planning, grid congestion and flexibility.

  • Think like an entrepreneur and see public funding as a path to a business case.

  • Are curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Speak business-fluent German and bring good English for EU programmes.

What we offer

  • A business line you build from scratch, with a direct line to the management team.

  • Real financial leverage: what you win shows up directly in RIZM's cash flow.

  • A product already running at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

  • Salary plus equity.

How to apply

No cover letter needed. We'd rather hear how you think. Two questions, a few honest sentences each:

  • A mayor gives you 5 minutes in an elevator. What do you tell them about RIZM?

  • What's the most absurd hurdle you've hit in public funding or procurement, and how did you get around it?

title: (Senior) Business & Financial Analyst (all genders)
description:
Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich. 

Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams.

  • Planung: Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen.

  • Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick.

  • Business Cases & Unit Economics: Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum.

  • Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten.

  • Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen.

AI-native arbeiten

AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse.

  • Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks.

  • Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten.



DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach.

  • Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau.

  • Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast.

  • Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen.

  • Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer.

Noch Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen.

  • Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern.

  • Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt.

  • Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München.

UNSERE BENEFITS

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexibilität: Teile dir selbst deine Arbeitszeiten ein - bei uns im Office, zu Hause oder remote aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
description:
Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances.

We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.

We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them.

  • Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud.

  • Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems.

  • Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles.

  • Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards.

  • Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field.

  • Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team.




What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code.

  • A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

  • The ability to understand a complex system and its domain quickly, and to translate that understanding into clear architecture and well-scoped tasks.

  • Hands-on experience working with AI coding agents, or the curiosity and drive to build that skill fast, including the judgment to verify and correct what they produce.

  • Day-to-day experience with Linux as a development and target environment.

  • Experience with distributed, real-time or performance-critical systems.

  • A solid testing mindset, from unit tests to hardware-in-the-loop or simulation.

  • Clear communication and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience with robotics, autonomy or sensor integration.

  • Experience setting up agent-based workflows, such as parallel agents, automated test and review loops or custom tooling around coding agents.

  • Embedded or real-time experience (RTOS, bare metal, firmware).

  • Familiarity with ROS 2 or simulation frameworks.

  • Knowledge of communication protocols and low-latency data transport.

  • Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

description:
Rust Engineer

Location: Berlin and surrounding

At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishably from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use them.

With its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies, voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate.

Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as a major German VC fund, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast.

We are building the future of communication.

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Your Role

Many core parts of our model stack are written in Rust. At the heart of it is our inference engine, written entirely in Rust.

Your mission is to build and improve these systems. You will work on the inference engine, take ownership of other Rust projects, and help decide how everything fits together. We need someone who enjoys writing good Rust code and can design software that stays understandable and maintainable as it grows.

Our models need to respond in real time. The software you build will directly influence how fast and reliable they are in an actual conversation.

What You'll Do

  • Build in Rust: Develop our inference engine and other core components of the model stack. Take projects from the first architectural decisions to running in production.

  • Design the Architecture: Decide how components and services communicate, where responsibilities belong, and how we can extend the system without making it harder to work on.

  • Work on Real-Time Systems: Build async Rust systems that handle concurrent workloads and streaming audio with low latency.

  • Improve Performance: Find bottlenecks, understand what's causing them, and improve latency, throughput, and resource usage.

  • Write Production-Ready Code: Build software that we can test, debug, and operate reliably. Help improve our tooling, documentation, and development practices along the way.

What We're Looking For: Must-Haves

  • Strong hands-on experience with Rust, including ownership, borrowing, composition, and idiomatic Rust design patterns.

  • Solid experience with async Rust. You know how to structure concurrent applications and deal with synchronization, cancellation, and backpressure.

  • Experience building and working with microservice architectures.

  • A true startup mindset: You are comfortable navigating the glorious chaos of an early-stage codebase. Inconsistent structures, missing docs. You name it, you'll help fix it.

  • Drive and Vision: You aren't just looking to blindly process Jira tickets. You want to actively shape the product, architect solutions, and take complete project ownership.

Ideally, You Also Bring

  • Experience with real-time systems, whether in embedded environments or the cloud. Both are relevant to us.

  • Experience with C/C++ interoperability, including generating Rust bindings with bindgen.

  • German, spoken and written.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with CUDA or GPU computing.

  • Contributions to open-source projects.

  • Python knowledge.

  • Experience with lower-level performance engineering, such as debugging memory leaks or understanding performance at the machine instruction level.

What We Offer

  • Technical Ownership: Our Rust stack is central to the company. You'll have the trust and freedom to make architectural decisions and see them through.

title: Senior Engineer - IAM and Workplace Technology
description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll join Tech as a Senior Engineer. Tech owns identity and access, IT and workplace technology for the whole company. Today it's a Workplace Tech engineer and an IAM engineer, and you'll be the most senior engineer on the team.

This is a hands-on role. You'll work the access and IT queue with the team, and you'll lead the technical work that shrinks it: the automation, the identity platform and the roadmap. As Primer grows and the team grows with it, there's room for the role to grow too, including into leading the team for the right person.

Tech is an enablement team. It sits alongside Security Engineering, not inside it, and owns the request queue and the tools that keep everyone at Primer productive. Primer is growing fast, and access requests are growing even faster. Our job is to make getting the right access quick, safe and mostly automatic, so people can get on with their work and our security engineers can get back to security.

What you'll be doing

  • Work the IAM, IT and Workplace Tech queue alongside the team, and set the bar for turnaround and quality.

  • Lead the technical roadmap for Tech and deliver it, starting with SCIM day-1 provisioning, Okta, automated access reviews and device enrolment.

  • Automate the routine. Use identity tooling, scripting, workflow automation and AI to take repetitive access requests off people's plates.

  • Run joiner, mover and leaver processes so new starters have what they need on day one and access is removed promptly when it should be.

  • Keep access controls audit-ready. Work with Security and GRC on access reviews, least privilege and evidence for PCI DSS and SOC 2.

  • Partner with Security Engineering on the calls that need them, such as privileged access and policy exceptions, and handle the rest within Tech.

  • Mentor the other engineers on the team, review their work and share what you know.

  • Track and report on how the queue is doing: volume, turnaround, and how much automation is taking off it.

What we're looking for

  • Senior-level experience in IT, IAM or corporate engineering at a fast-growing tech company

  • Hands-on with an identity provider (Okta preferred; Entra ID, Google Workspace or similar also welcome), including SSO, SCIM and lifecycle management

  • A track record of automating manual IT and access work, with scripting, workflow tools or APIs

  • Experience with SaaS administration and endpoint management (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Intune)

  • Good judgement about access: you understand least privilege and know when something needs a security review

  • Experience owning projects end to end and helping others on the team level up

  • Clear, friendly written communication. Much of the job is helping colleagues across the business

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments or another regulated environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001)

  • Experience running access reviews and providing audit evidence

  • Using AI tools to speed up support and operations work

  • Experience scaling an IT function through a period of fast headcount growth

You may not like it here if...

  • You're looking for a management role. This is a hands-on senior engineering role.

  • You'd rather follow an established playbook. A lot of this is being set up for the first time, and you'll be the one defining how it works.

  • You prefer to fix requests one at a time rather than remove the reasons they come in. We measure success by how much of the queue disappears.

  • Shifting priorities frustrate you. We're a growing company and the team's focus will change as we scale.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. About us

We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment.

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

The role

This is an opportunity to support across Encord's entire growth function: from our billboards or campaigns on X, to our exec dinners, founder PR or flagship annual summit.

In a single week you might organize our booth at a robotics conference, run a monthly dinner with executives at companies we most want to meet and uncover a gap in our LLM ranking and ship new content to improve it. You'll have a founder-mentality, move with relentless urgency, and own outcomes rather than tasks.

If you want to start a company one day, or already have, this is a chance to experience a hyper-growth GTM function from 0 to 1. You'll see up close how a category-defining company gets built and get as much scope as you can handle (as fast as you can earn it). Our team is small and we all roll up our sleeves, from packing hundreds of swag boxes, to cold outbounding a famous podcast to book our founders an interview.

Some of what you could own in your first months:

  • Growth hacks: test scrappy, creative ways to get in front of the AI leaders at companies we most want to work with; obsess about finding out what's actually working and doubling down

  • Content distribution: help put Encord on the map, from understanding where our market spends time online/IRL to helping create and distribute high-value content that reflects our leadership in the space

  • Conferences: prep and run our presence at large conferences, from booking meetings ahead of time to working the booth and following up with leads

  • A bold IRL launch: help take an out-of-home campaign or stunt in New York or SF from idea to street, from sourcing locations to capturing the content once it's live

  • Executive dinners: own the guest list, venue and follow-up for dinners with the AI teams at the companies we most want to work with

  • Customer stories: turn customer wins into case studies, videos and posts that our GTM team can use to communicate the value of Encord

  • Take full ownership of projects as you prove yourself, coming up with your own ideas for how Encord can grow and executing on them

  • Write and ship wide-ranging media formats: social posts that resonate with our market, press releases to announce a big launch, outbound emails to book meetings, video scripts or podcast outlines

  • Examine the performance of what you deliver, track results and proactively identify what's working/not working (and quickly adapt)

Who we're looking for

  • 1–3 years in a high-velocity environment: starting a company as a founder, top-tier banking or investing, early hire at a hyper-growth startup, or similar. Exceptional new grads will be considered

  • High-agency and founder-mentality: you have a strong sense of self-initiative and often find a creative solution around obstacles where others get stuck

  • Eager for a non-linear growth path (and driven to put in the work needed to achieve it)

  • Customer-centric and sales-focused: you want to deeply understand how our business works, why our customers choose Encord and what makes a 'great' Encord customer; you want to learn to speak the language of our market and be respected by customers/prospects, have them on speed-dial

  • Ruthlessly focused on results: you internalize our north start metrics and goals, and refuse to spend time on 'vanity' tasks or initiatives that don't help us make progress

  • You want to roll up your sleeves: you know most of the work required to grow a company is not glamorous, and you deeply care to do a great job on every sub-component required to get to the result

  • You're curious, and always hunting for, new avenues for growth: you want to find new S curves for the company and can juggle 'always on' with bold new bets

  • Evidence that you make things happen: events, projects, campaigns, or businesses you drove yourself

Why Encord

  • Generational opportunity to shape how AI will develop in the real-world

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a hyper-growth startup

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

This role offers the opportunity to have a genuine impact on how we operate, how we support our customers and how we bring our next generation of AI capabilities to market.

We're looking for someone who brings substantial experience leading customer-facing technical teams, alongside the technical depth to challenge, guide and contribute to solution development. Our AI-powered platform connects patent intelligence, scientific research, Life Sciences data and market insights, helping organisations make more informed decisions, accelerate R&D and bring new innovations to market.

Vocca in a few words

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

  • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

  • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

  • Opening the US market

The problem

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding.

What you will own

  • The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

  • Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

  • The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed.

  • The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. The hard integrations are the ones nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

  • The team. You define how this scope works (reviews, documentation, technical decisions), you take part in hiring the next engineers and you help them ship in their first week.

How we build

  • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

  • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here

  • 6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run.

  • You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. You can tell us who it was for, what problem it solved and which number moved.

  • You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world.

  • Strong in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the stack.

  • You think about the product and the business as much as the code. You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.

  • You are at ease with clients and partners, in French and in English.

Probably not for you if you want to manage without coding, or if you need a stable, fully specified environment before you move.

What we expect from you

  • First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first fix on a live integration is in production.

  • First month. You own one integration end to end, from the software vendor to production, and show what it changed. You write down how our booking layer should evolve.

  • First 3 months. The unified booking layer in TypeScript is the standard. Adding a new software takes days, not weeks. We detect a booking failure in any clinic within 24 hours.

  • 6 to 12 months. Our first US integrations run in production. You have hired at least one engineer and they ship on their own.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 2h in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • Hybrid, 3 days at the office.

  • BSPCE.

The opportunity
 
We are looking for an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) to help us scale our engineering team. Because we have EPMs almost since the beginning of Pigment, the role is already well-known. Our team is central to the engineering organization, perceived as a force multiplier by all the other engineers. We are constantly on the lookout to improve how we work. We like to try new ideas, whether it is to accelerate delivery, structure the organization or develop a unique culture. By joining our passionate, close-knitted team, you can have an impact in many different ways and learn in a team that is both young and fast-growing! 
Here is what the day-to-day of an EPM looks like at Pigment:
 
Deliver: You make a difference every day in the engineering team(s) you are working with, as you enhance clarity, direction, scope, and keep all the parts together with other roles (such as Product Managers). Typically an EPM accompanies 1 to 3 teams in their delivery, ranging from technical projects (e.g. scalability and performance, SRE) to more functional ones (e.g. bringing automations to our product).
 
Scale: You contribute to the engineering instances wherever you can bring added value. For instance, you can contribute to maintaining a healthy release pipeline, participate to incident response, oversee improvements to our monitoring and alerting practices…You also lead initiatives of various sizes to tackle the needs and issues that arise when growing as an organization. For instance, suggest evolutions to roles and responsibilities, better organize knowledge management, or work on large-scale projects related to quality management and production stability.
 
Federate: You contribute to the general well-being of the team, upon opportunity and based on affinity, for example as an organizer of regular instances (all-hands meetings, newsletters…), hackathons, team building activities, and any other idea related to the promotion of Pigment culture internally and externally. You also contribute to Pigment hiring and branding initiatives.
 
The team
As a team, we have a mission statement and a roadmap that we maintain over time. We are open to different styles and we rotate responsibilities and projects on a regular basis between us. We regularly exchange on our challenges in “co-development” sessions and sound new ideas to one another. You will also grow as an individual thanks to a career ladder and a culture of on-going feedback.
 
Explore Our Tech Blog:
If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture, and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog!
 
Who you are
 
We expect demonstrated experience in helping technical teams build and run in a fast-paced environment, with the right touch of processes and empowerment of individuals. 
 
Technical project/product management, engineering management, quality engineering, and production-related roles are typically the kind of roles where such an experience is demonstrated, but we are open to a diversity of backgrounds.
 
Experience as a software engineer is a plus but not required. The position does not involve coding. You should be able to read and understand code and read / comment / challenge a technical design.
 
To help you better understand the role, here are the qualities we are looking for in an EPM:
Resourcefulness: you like to be dropped in a new context and come up with your own solutions 
Change management: you are a people person and you convey change smartly and courageously
Diligence: you are curious and connect the dots in ways no one else can, you strive to reach alignment through shared understanding, clarity, and direction
Integrity: you lead by example, inspire others, and always play “first team”
 
The position doesn’t involve people management.
Fluency in English (French not required)

title: Stage 2 Mois - 35H - Conseiller De Vente (H/F) - Galeries Lafayettes Nice
description:
LA MAISON
 
Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.
 
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE
 
En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus.
 
Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits.
 
 
VOS MISSIONS
 
·       Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente.
·       Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour leur offrir une expérience exceptionnelle.
·       Découvrir et partager votre expertise sur nos produits auprès des clients.
·       Faire preuve de proactivité en suggérant des produits complémentaires.
·       Contribuer à la fidélisation de notre clientèle en développant des relations privilégiées.
·       Assurer la bonne tenue du point de vente en collaboration avec l’équipe.
·       Participer aux missions opérationnelles : Visual merchandising, réassort, gestion des stocks, SAV.
·       Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines.
·       Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence.
 
PROFIL
 
·       Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de mode ou de management, avec une forte sensibilité pour l’univers de la mode et du luxe.
·       Première expérience en vente ou relation client appréciée.
·       Excellentes capacités de communication et sens du service client.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range.

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐

You may be a great fit at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data‑driven and analytical: you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

  • Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR or Finance

.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.
